interruption.method: One real public call: synthetic speech interrupts active compressed MP3 playback, then a second utterance completes. First 1.35 seconds of a synthetic fixture through actual browser AudioWorklet and provider requests; no physical microphone or hardware output latency.

notes: Synthetic audio; no physical microphone or hardware output-latency measurement.
Alternating comparison changes only advertised callPipeline capability, using the same deployed model, prompt and audio buffering. Three samples per path cannot establish tail latency.

Other-wait estimate subtracts server ASR provider, model and first-audio durations from browser end-of-input-to-scheduled-playback. It includes VAD, upload, transport, admission and browser scheduling, not network RTT alone.
Model transport experiment waits for complete JSON; first non-streaming request uses a cold connection. No promotion based on this small sample.
